notes: Portable C++ and Java translation of the mapped native two-member next-message timed-save case. The adapter supplies provider, FOM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. With HLA_EVOKED callbacks, an NMR grant equal to the first save time 5 initiates save before its grant callback; both members complete it. A replacement timed save at 7 then remains pending after an equal NMRA grant 7, while a later NMRA grant 8 initiates the replacement save before grant; both members complete again. Direct traceability is limited to four pinned requirement-section pairs in clauses 4.19, 4.19.6, and 4.20. C++ primary and contract passed against an installed package under integer64 and float64 time using an adapter-supplied portable FOM. Java compiles against the official API only; provider runtime is unverified. The per-recipient callback-service sequence is an experimental public observation, not a universal cross-service ordering, immediate-callback, transport, interoperability, or conformance claim.
